places.name: Fountain Square
places.description: The heart of town: a fountain, market stalls, and a bench under the lanterns.

places.name: Town Hall
places.description: Where the mayor keeps the town ledger and the notice board.

places.name: Crumb & Co. Bakery
places.description: Warm bread from dawn. The best place in town to hear news.

places.name: The Kettle Cafe
places.description: Tea, coffee, and a terrace with three wobbly tables.

places.name: Lantern Library
places.description: Quiet shelves, town records, and a reading nook.

places.name: Pine Workshop
places.description: Sawdust, half-built chairs, and the smell of pine.

places.name: Willow Pond
places.description: A calm pond with a little dock. Good for fishing and painting.

places.name: Community Garden
places.description: Pumpkins, carrots, and a scarecrow nobody admits to building.

places.name: Honey Cottage
places.description: A yellow cottage near the bakery.

places.name: Ivy Cottage
places.description: A cottage covered in ivy, west of the library.

places.name: Oak Cottage
places.description: A sturdy cottage next to the workshop.

places.name: Maple Cottage
places.description: A red-roofed cottage past the garden.

residents.name: Bea Crumb
residents.persona: Warm, chatty, up before dawn. Loves feeding people and loves news even more. Repeats what she hears, a little improved.

residents.name: Otto Pembrook
residents.persona: Pompous but kind. Worries about the town's reputation. Hates surprises and loves speeches.

residents.name: Lin Ashby
residents.persona: Quiet and skeptical. Asks for sources. Rarely repeats a rumor unless she believes it.

residents.name: Rafa Moss
residents.persona: Talks to every customer. Remembers everyone's order and everyone's secrets. Dramatic storyteller.

residents.name: Juniper Vale
residents.persona: Dreamy, gentle, talks to her pumpkins. Believes the best about everyone.

residents.name: Tobias Fenn
residents.persona: Gruff, loyal, few words. Defends his friends and distrusts gossip.

residents.name: Mae Hollis
residents.persona: Walks the whole town every day with the post. Knows everyone and passes news along with the letters.

residents.name: Wren Calloway
residents.persona: Romantic and imaginative. Paints by the pond. Turns every rumor into a love story.

residents.name: Ike Bramble
residents.persona: Tells tall tales about the fish that got away. Easily convinced, easily excited.

residents.name: Dot Pennywhistle
residents.persona: Sits on the square bench and watches everything. Nosy, sharp, and fond of correcting people.
